bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
work="$repo/.worktrees/creator-menu-20261115"
test "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)" = b69612c64c22af1540b7294625658ebffa946270 || { echo LIVE_CHECKOUT_CHANGED; exit 74; }
test ! -e "$work" || { echo WORKTREE_ALREADY_EXISTS; exit 73; }
git -C "$repo" fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core
head="$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)"
test "$head" = d8de8f8912ee1d19b2a2bf2171c6cb66d51783a5 || { echo REMOTE_HEAD_CHANGED; exit 74; }
mkdir -p "$repo/.worktrees"
git -C "$repo" worktree add --detach "$work" "$head"
echo "CREATEVDO_BUILD_START"
if docker build --pull=false --progress=plain --file "$work/deploy/Dockerfile" --tag create-videobot:creator-menu-d8de8f8 "$work" > /tmp/createvdo-menu-build-20261115.log 2>&1; then
 echo "CREATEVDO_IMAGE_BUILD=PASS"
 docker image inspect --format 'CANDIDATE_IMAGE={{.Id}}' create-videobot:creator-menu-d8de8f8
 docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node create-videobot:creator-menu-d8de8f8 -e "import('/opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorEgress.mjs').then(()=>console.log('UNDICI_MODULE=PASS'))" || { echo MODULE_TEST_FAIL; exit 3; }
else
 tail -35 /tmp/createvdo-menu-build-20261115.log | sed -E 's#[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{50,}#[REDACTED]#g'
 echo CREATEVDO_IMAGE_BUILD=FAIL
 exit 1
fi
echo "EXISTING_CONTAINER=$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Status}} {{.Config.Image}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1)"
echo "COMPOSE_LABELS"
docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}|{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.service"}}|{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}}|{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
echo "SOURCE_HEAD=$head"
echo CREATEVDO_BUILD_END
